sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 11864 of 2023
Petitioner :- Manoj Kumar

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vishal Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
This petition has been reported to be beyond time by 242 days.
However, keeping in view the fact that the order impugned is not being interfered with, laches are ignored.

2. Heard Sri Manu Gildiyal, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Vishal Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State - respondents.
3.

It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that by ex parte order dated 07.05.2022,
proceedings under Section 176 of U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 were decided and on the basis thereof the private respondent no.3 received certain compensation in the proceedings arising out of land acquisition.
4.

entities.text: U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The submission of learned counsel is that having come to know about the order dated 10.01.2023 regarding compensation, the petitioner filed an application under Order 9 Rule 13 C.P.C. before the Sub-Divisional Officer, Tehsil Badlapur, District Jaunpur which is pending seeking recall of order dated 07.05.2022.
5.

Although, prayer for quashing ex parte order dated 07.05.2022 has been made, since recall Manoj Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182259244/
1 application is already pending, prayer for quashing the said order is refused.

entities.text: Manoj Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. This petition is disposed of directing the Sub-Divisional Officer, Tehsil Badlapur, District Jaunpur to decide the application under Order 9 Rule 13 C.P.C. within a period of three months from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before him after giving opportunity of hearing to the respondent no.3.
7.

In case, the lawyers do not cooperate with the proceedings either on account of abstainment from work or otherwise, the court concerned shall permit personal appearance of the parties to address it on the merits of the aforesaid case.

However, the authority/court concerned shall take special care of the fact that the property rights of the parties may not be adversely affected only on account of non-cooperation of the lawyers and the aforesaid matter shall be disposed of strictly in accordance with law, taking care of the statutory provisions and after making critical analysis of the material available on record.

Order Date :- 19.4.2023 Atul  Manoj Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182259244/
2
